title: Length contraction
references: Einstein, A., Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Koerper, Annalen der Physik 322(10), 891-921 (1905), doi:10.1002/andp.19053221004
Rindler, W., Relativity: Special, General, and Cosmological, 2nd ed., Oxford University Press (2006)
validity_domain: Length along the direction of motion of a body at constant speed v < c, measured in a frame where it moves, given its proper length L0.
limitations: Length along the direction of motion only; transverse lengths do not contract
Length defined by simultaneous marking of both ends in the observer frame, which is not what a camera records
The 0.5 % tolerance covers the rounding of a stated figure, it is not a physical uncertainty

variables.L0: Proper length, in the rest frame of the body
variables.v: Speed of the body in the observer frame
